metadata.title: Packablock EU CRA Third-Party Audit & Agency Assessment Pricing Benchmarks
metadata.purpose: Empirical cost benchmarks for micro-enterprises and SMEs outsourcing CRA compliance assessment
primary_authorities: European Commission Staff Working Document SWD(2022) 282 final
IANS Research / SANS Cybersecurity Consulting Rate Card Surveys
European Digital SME Alliance Focus Group on Cybersecurity
European Commission NANDO (New Approach Notified and Designated Organisations)

pricing_benchmarks.scope_of_work: High-level architecture review, Article 7 product classification, essential requirements gap analysis (Annex I), and compliance roadmap.
pricing_benchmarks.public_data_source: IANS Research Security Advisory Rate Survey & Cyber Ireland Benchmarks

pricing_benchmarks.service_tier_name: Technical Construction File & Module A Dossier Prep
pricing_benchmarks.scope_of_work: Hands-on technical documentation drafting (Annex II), risk assessment file, automated CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM pipeline audit, and EU Declaration of Conformity preparation.
pricing_benchmarks.deliverable_format: Complete Annex II Technical File + CE Documentation Package
pricing_benchmarks.public_data_source: European Commission Impact Assessment SWD(2022) 282 final (SME Unit Costs)

pricing_benchmarks.service_tier_name: Product Security Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Audit
pricing_benchmarks.scope_of_work: Grey-box application pen testing, API security verification, dependency exploitability validation, and CVD security.txt response dry run.
pricing_benchmarks.deliverable_format: Attestation Penetration Test Report & CVD Workflow Validation
pricing_benchmarks.public_data_source: CREST International Commercial Penetration Testing Rate Benchmark

pricing_benchmarks.service_tier_name: Hardware Embedded Security & Lab Evaluation (EMC/Radio/Secure Boot)
pricing_benchmarks.scope_of_work: Physical board tampering verification, hardware root of trust audit, RF/firmware extraction tests, and EU RED + CRA dual-directive testing.
pricing_benchmarks.deliverable_format: Laboratory Hardware Test Certificate & Red Teaming Report
pricing_benchmarks.public_data_source: Eurofins / TÜV SÜD Lab Certification Schedules & RED Delegated Act Benchmarks
pricing_benchmarks.statutory_legal_basis: CRA Annex I Part I & Directive 2014/53/EU (RED)

pricing_benchmarks.service_tier_name: Notified Body EU-Type Examination (Module B + C)
pricing_benchmarks.scope_of_work: Mandatory formal external audit of technical construction file, examination of product specifications, and issuance of formal EU-Type Examination Certificate.
pricing_benchmarks.target_product_class: Important Class I (without harmonised standards) & Important Class II
pricing_benchmarks.deliverable_format: Formal EU-Type Examination Certificate (CE Marking Authorized)
pricing_benchmarks.public_data_source: European Commission NANDO Information System & Notified Body Association Benchmarks
pricing_benchmarks.statutory_legal_basis: CRA Art. 24(2) & Annex II (Module B + C)

pricing_benchmarks.service_tier_name: Outsourced Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure (CVD) & 24h Triage Retainer
pricing_benchmarks.scope_of_work: Designated security.txt mailbox management, 24-hour statutory early-warning SLA for actively exploited CVEs, CSIRT/ENISA notification dispatch, and patch coordination.
pricing_benchmarks.target_product_class: All Commercial Products with Digital Elements
pricing_benchmarks.deliverable_format: 24/7 Monitored CVD Ingestion Portal & Statutory CSIRT Escalation Dispatch
pricing_benchmarks.public_data_source: European Digital SME Alliance Cybersecurity Survey & ENISA Market Observatory
